data.name: Chetan
data.gender_notes: Chetan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root cit, 'to perceive, know' — cetana, 'consciousness'. Its root is Sanskrit cit (चित्). A classical Sanskrit term for consciousness. Chetan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Consciousness; awareness; spirit”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Chetan expresses “Consciousness; awareness; spirit”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root cit, 'to perceive, know' — cetana, 'consciousness'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chetan total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

data.cultural_impact: Chetan is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Consciousness; awareness; spirit”.

vedic_reference.note: Chetan is a name of Lord Vishnu and also a name of Lord Krishna. It is mentioned in various Vedic texts and Puranas.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for consciousness.

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Chetan.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.
